desc: Hard cut from corkboard scene (slumped man, small laptop) to close desk scene with bespectacled man, ORDER box and paper stacks.
Hard cut from cluttered scene to wordmark, calm smiling man and app grid. FLAG: this pre-'FREE' composition lasts to ~f10121.
Pricing screenshot slides in from the right over the dimmed app grid while 'for FREE!' fades and the man switches to a wink.
Article page begins scrolling up under the cursor; photo and jump list rise, man with pointer stays at right.
Scroll continues; article cover moves up revealing jump list and the first section heading.
Article scroll progresses; photo exits top, jump list and body intro text rise in; man unchanged.
Continuing page scroll: photo nearly off-screen, jump list centred, section text below.
Scroll continues; jump list moves toward top while first section paragraph fills the lower half.
Page keeps scrolling; jump list leaving top, body paragraphs filling the screenshot; man static.
Scroll nearly past the intro; paragraph text dominates, man with pointer still at right.
Article now full-width text; man larger at lower-right as scroll nearly settles; man's scale change begins.
Body text nearly settled while the man slides right and scales up, pointer crossing the paragraphs.
Man continues enlarging toward the lower-right; text scroll almost still.
Man nears final size at the right edge; paragraph text steady.
Final settling of the enlarged man over the article text; scroll finished.
Hard cut from highlighted article text with large man to blank white canvas with first money bags popping in.
Bag grid replaced by dense dollar-bill rain; faint Alphabet wordmark appears underneath at post+2.
Bill rain continues; Alphabet wordmark visible under translucent bills; bags gone.
Bills thicken and rotate; Alphabet remains the only logo behind them.
Bill rain mid-fall; Alphabet shows faintly, no other logos yet.
Bills keep falling; Alphabet visible, a trace of amazon appears at post+2.
Alphabet clear; amazon wordmark starts fading in below it as bills drift.
amazon wordmark gains opacity beneath Alphabet while bills keep rotating.
Alphabet and amazon both visible through the falling bills.
amazon with orange arrow clearer; bill layers shift diagonally.
Bills swirl; Alphabet and amazon visible, no Meta yet.
Alphabet and amazon clear; bills layered over them and drifting.
amazon arrow visible; bills overlap the logos as the rain continues.
Alphabet and amazon visible; bills rotate across the canvas.
Meta logo begins to appear beneath amazon at post+2 as bills fall.
Meta fades in under amazon while bills continue falling.
Alphabet, amazon and Meta visible; Microsoft not yet present.
Three logos visible (Alphabet, amazon, Meta); bills keep drifting.
Meta clearly legible; bill layer thins slightly.
Microsoft squares begin appearing right of Meta; bills continue falling.
Microsoft logo faint under bills; Meta clear.
Microsoft emerging under the bills; four logos partly visible.
Four logos faintly visible; bills still falling diagonally.
Microsoft clearer beside Meta; bills layered over the upper logos.
Four logos visible with Microsoft in colour; bill rain continues.
Same four logos; bills drift; no Oracle yet.
Microsoft and Meta legible; amazon partly hidden behind bills.
Four logos behind bills; Oracle still not visible.
Four logos visible; bills continue their diagonal fall.
Oracle begins to appear at the bottom of the logo stack.
Oracle red letters emerge under Microsoft while bills keep falling.
Oracle clearly visible; all five logos present under the bills.
All five logos present; bills drifting and overlapping.
Five logos visible; Oracle crisp; bill density decreasing slightly.
Five logos hold behind the bill rain; some bills fade out.
Logo stack steady; bills continue to fall and overlap.
Bill rain continues over five logos; individual bills translucent.
Same logo stack under falling bills; bills shift diagonally.
Bills still falling over the logos; no layout change.
Bill layer begins to thin; five logos remain in the same positions.
Bills falling with fewer overlaps; logo stack unchanged.
Bill rain over steady five-logo stack; bills drifting out.
Logos steady; bills overlap lightly and keep falling.
Same stack under thinning bill rain.
Bills still drifting; logo layout stable.
Falling bills fewer; logos unchanged.
Bill rain continues to clear; logo stack unchanged.
Final bills falling; five logos still centre-left, not yet at the final position.
Bills nearly gone; logo stack still centred.
Last bills fade; post+2 frame shows medal with the five-logo stack settled at the right.
Hard cut from the sad man, medal and logos slide to a scrolling bank article page (Exhibit chart, then text); start of scroll.
